generator: built-in ChatGPT image generator; exact model version not exposed
packing: Generated RGBA resized to source4x and minimally globally aligned. Original alpha via marching-squares contours with <=.4sourcepx rounded corners; every original pixel midpoint preserved. Aligned generated interior RGB unchanged, missing edge RGB extended from nearest generated material. No original RGB, per-row anatomy warp, or raster replacement. Generated eye photo material repacked inside exact original index1 eye contour. Old misplaced eye/socket uses a separately generated eyeless blue photo-skin patch when supplied; nearest blue diagnostic otherwise. Original alpha unchanged; no original RGB introduced. Separat generert lokal hudovergang er pakket etter originalkallets eksakte plasseringer, med uendret alfa.

original_flat_shadow_packing.method: Originalt flatt svart indeks5-fotskyggefelt bevares med eksakt naermeste4x-alfa i sitt kildebekreftede rektangel. Generert foto brukes bare i kropp/fot; ingen nytegning av skyggen paastaas.

generated_eyeless_skin_patch.method: Only the generated eyeless photo skin patch is packed; all other RGB and all alpha retain the original candidate. Two HD pixels feather the patch boundary.

source_join_material.method: Separat generert fotohud pakkes bare i kildebekreftet fragmentskjoet, med aatte HD-piksler innfasing. Alfa og alt RGB utenfor stripe beholdes eksakt. Ingen originaltekstur brukes.
